dedupe_keys.name: shear wave velocity datafiles for sites in central and eastern north america as compiled by the geotechnical working group as part of the nga east project

description: Shear wave velocity datafiles for sites in central and eastern North America as compiled by the Geotechnical Working Group as part of the NGA-East project is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Albert Kottke, Pacific Gas & Electric (pge.com). This dataset consists of 725 shear-wave velocity (Vs) and 212 compression-wave velocity (Vp) profiles measured at sites in central and eastern North America, as well as Vs30 values for 2,358 sites derived from in situ measurements. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-evrj-6992. Keywords: velocity profile, vs30, site characterization, CENA. Published 2023-02-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
